show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/vmfVUx
show.description: Summary: Kartik is a movie superstar who feels that this movie world is fake, and decides to retire from it. On the other hand, a humble writer Alisha writes a story and puts the condition to the Producer that she will act as the Heroine in this film. Alisha becomes Kartik’s fake girlfriend, and later they actually fall in love. After more complications, emotions and “hungama”, our hero and heroine finally come together.
